findings.claim: CheckPolicy decides between hard error and silent free-mode pass on base-resolution failure using the untrusted working-tree policy's Mode and BaseRef, so tampering acdsl/policy.json to {"mode":"free","base_ref":"nosuchref"} silently defeats the gate on gated/strict repos.
findings.fix: Never trust the working file's Mode on the base-resolution failure path: either always hard-error when a policy file is present at all (only a truly absent acdsl/policy.json implies free), or resolve base_ref only from a trusted source (try the default candidate chain unconditionally first, using the working BaseRef only as an additional candidate, never the sole one); add a regression test combining tampered mode: free with an unresolvable/attacker-controlled base_ref.

findings.claim: Two substantial security/behavior-relevant additions — the new skill-invoke-gate.sh PreToolUse hook and the row-level verdict cache in cmd/worktrees/print_agent_worktrees_status.sh — trace to no plan in this release, violating the traceability doctrine.
findings.fix: Confirm with the operator that both were intended as part of this release, and either add a retroactive plan note (giving them their own review pass) or flag them as scope creep.

findings.claim: The repo Add form adds a user-editable name input that overrides Repo.Name, deviating from the language-style-setting plan's C16/G17 design that identity is derived from the folder and only Label is editable, with no plan changelog row.
findings.fix: Confirm this was a deliberate scope addition and record it as a decision in the plan rather than shipping it silently.

findings.claim: handleProfileTest diverged from the smine-profile-settings plan's D8/D9 (rewritten prompt and a styleTestTarget model override from ROUTINE_MODEL) without any Changelog entry recording the change.
findings.fix: Add Changelog rows to the smine-profile-settings plan documenting the prompt rewrite and the styleTestTarget introduction so the frozen plan is not misleading.

findings.claim: cmd.Wait()'s return value is silently dropped in the background goroutine, leaving no server-side trace when a bootstrap run exits non-zero.
findings.fix: Log the exit status (e.g. log.Printf on non-nil error) so finished-vs-crashed is distinguishable from server state.

findings.claim: styleTestPrompt relies purely on prompt compliance to prevent tool use while the profile-test call runs with the full default permission surface.
findings.fix: Consider passing --disallowedTools as a second layer rather than relying only on the prompt.
